title: Auth — OOB Claim — payload
description: An approver claims a pending out-of-band request, locking it to a throwaway Ed25519 key (`K_a`) generated for this one exchange. The document is the first request of a trigger-link exchange (VTI-LNK-054): issued and signed by `K_a`, addressed to the service, and carrying the request's handle both here and as the envelope's `parentThreadId`. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, parentThreadId, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

requestId.description: The handle read from the trigger link's `_id`. MUST equal the document's `parentThreadId`.

Response.title: Auth — OOB Claim — response payload (step 1)
Response.description: Step 1 of the disclosure ladder, signed by the service's assertionMethod key: who the service is, where the request will be used and for what, and when the decision window closes. It MUST contain nothing about the starter.

decisionDeadline.description: When the decision window, started by this claim, closes. Prove, respond and redeem must all complete before it. At most 180 s after the claim; 120 s RECOMMENDED.
